description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
